ledger: Cups: four steel/copper cups on the green field at 00:00 (back, middle, right, front-left); stay four through 00:09.25
Middle cup: holds a near-rim stack of coins 00:00-00:02.75; no hand touches it afterward
Front-left cup: holds a gold coin 00:00-00:02; the hand reaches in at 00:01-00:02 and lifts the gold coin out at 00:02.25; the cup is empty at 00:02.5
Coin A (gold, held at fingertips): in the operator's hand at 00:00-00:00.5, occluded by both hands at 00:00.75-00:02, then in the same hand with coin B at 00:03.0-00:03.25

Coin B (gold, from the front-left cup): hand at 00:02.25-00:03.25; held at the front-left cup's rim at 00:03.5, then pressed against its outer wall by the near hand from 00:04.0 to about 00:08.0; still at the cup in the near hand at 00:08.5
Second coin (small gold): far hand at the back/right cup from 00:03.5 to about 00:06.75; the far hand stays at the right end of the row of cups
00:05-00:08: the camera pulls back and rotates; the four cups stand in a row; the operator keeps one coin in each hand at the ends of the row
00:08.75-00:09.25: the left hand holds a coin above the back cups; the right hand rests on the table beside the right cup; four cups are visible (00:09.0 frame and the dense 9.0-9.25 frames)
00:09.33-00:09.75: only three cups are visible (back, left, front); no hand lifted or carried a cup
Loose table coins in the green field (gold and silver near the cups): visible 00:00-00:05; few or none visible from about 00:07 on while the camera moves

findings.description: Four cups are visible in the row/cluster up to about 00:09.25, and only three from about 00:09.33. Through this window the left hand holds a coin in the air above the cups and the right hand rests flat on the table beside them. Neither hand grips, lifts, nests, or removes a cup, and no cup leaves the frame. A whole cup disappears, which concealed palming cannot explain.

findings.entity: coin stack inside the middle cup
findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:02.75 the middle cup holds a coin stack almost up to the rim, topped by an embossed gold/silver coin. At 00:03.0 the top coin looks like a different plain white/silver disc, and by 00:03.75-00:04.25 the contents sit noticeably lower or are no longer visible. No hand touches the middle cup during this time.

findings.entity: loose gold/silver coins on the green field near the cups
findings.description: Several loose gold and silver coins lie on the green field in front of the cups through about 00:05. In the wider shots from about 00:07 to 00:09.75 the green field around the cups is nearly empty, and no hand is seen collecting these coins. The camera move makes this less certain.
